verses.text_en: He answered me then, and said, Measure thou the time diligently in itself: and when thou seest part of the signs past, which I have told thee before,
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: Pomno mjeri vrijeme u sebi. Kad vidiš da je prošao dio znakova o kojima sam ti prije govorio,

verses.text_en: Then shalt thou understand, that it is the very same time, wherein the Highest will begin to visit the world which he made.
verses.text_hr: Tada ćeš shvatiti da je to isto vrijeme u kojem će Svevišnji početi posjećivati svijet koji je stvorio.

verses.text_en: Therefore when there shall be seen earthquakes and uproars of the people in the world:
verses.text_hr: Stoga kada se budu vidjeli potresi i pobune ljudi u svijetu:

verses.text_en: Then shalt thou well understand, that the most High spake of those things from the days that were before thee, even from the beginning.
verses.text_hr: Tada ćeš dobro razumjeti da je Svevišnji govorio o tim stvarima od dana koji su bili prije tebe, čak od početka.

verses.text_en: For like as all that is made in the world hath a beginning and an end, and the end is manifest:
verses.text_hr: Jer kao što sve što je stvoreno na svijetu ima početak i kraj, a kraj je očit:

verses.text_en: Even so the times also of the Highest have plain beginnings in wonder and powerful works, and endings in effects and signs.
verses.text_hr: Čak i vremena Svevišnjega imaju jasne početke u čudima i moćnim djelima, a završetke u učincima i znakovima.

verses.text_en: And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith, whereby ye have believed,
verses.text_hr: Svatko tko se spasi i svojim djelima i vjerom u koju ste povjerovali uspije umaći,

verses.text_en: Shall be preserved from the said perils, and shall see my salvation in my land, and within my borders: for I have sanctified them for me from the beginning.
verses.text_hr: Bit će sačuvan od spomenutih opasnosti i vidjet će moje spasenje u mojoj zemlji i unutar mojih granica, koje sam posvetio sebi od početka.

verses.text_en: Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways: and they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments.
verses.text_hr: Tada će biti jadni oni koji sada zlorabe moje putove, a oni koji su ih svojevoljno odbacili prebivat će u mukama.

verses.text_en: For such as in their life have received benefits, and have not known me;
verses.text_hr: Jer oni koji su u životu primili dobrobiti, a mene nisu upoznali;

verses.text_en: And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty, and, when as yet place of repentance was open unto them, understood not, but despised it;
verses.text_hr: I oni koji su mrzili moj zakon, dok su još imali slobodu, i, kada im je još bilo otvoreno mjesto pokajanja, nisu razumjeli, nego su ga prezirali;

verses.text_en: The same must know it after death by pain.
verses.text_hr: Oni će to nakon smrti spoznati kroz bol.

verses.text_en: And therefore be thou not curious how the ungodly shall be punished, and when: but enquire how the righteous shall be saved, whose the world is, and for whom the world is created.
verses.text_hr: Zato ne istražuj kako će i kada bezbožni biti kažnjeni, nego kako će se spasiti pravednici, kojima pripada svijet i radi kojih je stvoren.

verses.text_en: Then answered I and said,
verses.text_hr: Tada sam odgovorio i rekao,

verses.text_en: I have said before, and now do speak, and will speak it also hereafter, that there be many more of them which perish, than of them which shall be saved:
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam prije, i sada govorim, i govorit ću to i poslije, da je mnogo više onih koji će propasti, nego onih koji će se spasiti:

verses.text_en: Like as a wave is greater than a drop.
verses.text_hr: Kao što je val veći od kapi.

verses.text_en: And he answered me, saying, Like as the field is, so is also the seed; as the flowers be, such are the colours also; such as the workman is, such also is the work; and as the husbandman is himself, so is his husbandry also: for it was the time of the world.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: Kakva je njiva, takvo je sjeme; kakvo je cvijeće, takve su boje; kakav je radnik, takav je posao; kakav je ratar, takva je obrada. Takvo je bilo vrijeme svijeta.

verses.text_en: And now when I prepared the world, which was not yet made, even for them to dwell in that now live, no man spake against me.
verses.text_hr: Kad sam pripravio svijet koji još nije bio stvoren, za one koji sada u njemu prebivaju, nitko mi se nije protivio.

verses.text_en: For then every one obeyed: but now the manners of them which are created in this world that is made are corrupted by a perpetual seed, and by a law which is unsearchable rid themselves.
verses.text_hr: Tada su svi bili poslušni; sada su navike onih koji su stvoreni u ovome svijetu iskvarene trajnim sjemenom i neistraživim zakonom.

verses.text_en: So I considered the world, and, behold, there was peril because of the devices that were come into it.
verses.text_hr: Promotrio sam svijet i vidio da mu prijeti opasnost zbog nakana koje su u njega ušle.

verses.text_en: And I saw, and spared it greatly, and have kept me a grape of the cluster, and a plant of a great people.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam to i veoma ga poštedio; sačuvao sam sebi grozd iz vinograda i sadnicu velikoga naroda.

verses.text_en: Let the multitude perish then, which was born in vain; and let my grape be kept, and my plant; for with great labour have I made it perfect.
verses.text_hr: Neka propadne mnoštvo koje se uzalud rodilo, a moj grozd i moja sadnica neka budu sačuvani, jer sam ih uz velik trud doveo do savršenstva.

verses.text_en: Nevertheless, if thou wilt cease yet seven days more, (but thou shalt not fast in them,
verses.text_hr: Ako se povučeš još sedam dana — ali u njima nemoj postiti —

verses.text_en: But go into a field of flowers, where no house is builded, and eat only the flowers of the field; taste no flesh, drink no wine, but eat flowers only;)
verses.text_hr: Pođi u cvjetno polje gdje nema sagrađene kuće i jedi samo poljsko cvijeće. Ne kušaj meso i ne pij vino, nego jedi samo cvijeće.

verses.text_en: And pray unto the Highest continually, then will I come and talk with thee.
verses.text_hr: I neprestano se moli Svevišnjem, tada ću doći i razgovarati s tobom.

verses.text_en: So I went my way into the field which is called Ardath, like as he commanded me; and there I sat among the flowers, and did eat of the herbs of the field, and the meat of the same satisfied me.
verses.text_hr: Pošao sam u polje zvano Ardat, kako mi je zapovjedio. Sjeo sam među cvijeće, jeo poljsko bilje i tom se hranom nasitio.

verses.text_en: After seven days I sat upon the grass, and my heart was vexed within me, like as before:
verses.text_hr: Nakon sedam dana sjedio sam na travi, a srce mi je bilo uznemireno kao prije:

verses.text_en: And I opened my mouth, and began to talk before the most High, and said,
verses.text_hr: Otvorio sam usta i počeo govoriti pred Svevišnjim:

verses.text_en: O Lord, thou that shewest thyself unto us, thou wast shewed unto our fathers in the wilderness, in a place where no man treadeth, in a barren place, when they came out of Egypt.
verses.text_hr: O Gospodine, ti koji nam se javljaš, pokazao si se našim očevima u pustinji, na mjestu gdje nitko ne kroči, na neplodnom mjestu, kad su izašli iz Egipta.

verses.text_en: And thou spakest saying, Hear me, O Israel; and mark my words, thou seed of Jacob.
verses.text_hr: Govorio si: Čuj me, Izraele, i zapamti moje riječi, Jakovljevo potomstvo.

verses.text_en: For, behold, I sow my law in you, and it shall bring fruit in you, and ye shall be honoured in it for ever.
verses.text_hr: Jer, evo, sijem svoj zakon u vas, i on će donijeti plod u vama, i bit ćete u njemu čašćeni zauvijek.

verses.text_en: But our fathers, which received the law, kept it not, and observed not thy ordinances: and though the fruit of thy law did not perish, neither could it, for it was thine;
verses.text_hr: Ali naši oci, koji su primili Zakon, nisu ga čuvali ni obdržavali tvoje uredbe. Plod tvojega Zakona nije nestao niti je mogao nestati, jer je bio tvoj.

verses.text_en: Yet they that received it perished, because they kept not the thing that was sown in them.
verses.text_hr: Ali oni koji su ga primili propali su, jer nisu sačuvali što je u njima posijano.

verses.text_en: And, lo, it is a custom, when the ground hath received seed, or the sea a ship, or any vessel meat or drink, that, that being perished wherein it was sown or cast into,
verses.text_hr: Uobičajeno je da, kad zemlja primi sjeme, more brod, ili posuda hranu ili piće, nestane ono u čemu je nešto posijano ili pohranjeno,

verses.text_en: That thing also which was sown, or cast therein, or received, doth perish, and remaineth not with us: but with us it hath not happened so.
verses.text_hr: Dok posijano, bačeno ili primljeno ostaje. Ali s nama se nije tako dogodilo.

verses.text_en: For we that have received the law perish by sin, and our heart also which received it
verses.text_hr: Mi koji smo primili Zakon propadamo zbog grijeha, kao i naše srce koje ga je primilo,

verses.text_en: Notwithstanding the law perisheth not, but remaineth in his force.
verses.text_hr: Usprkos tome, zakon ne nestaje, nego ostaje u svojoj sili.

verses.text_en: And when I spake these things in my heart, I looked back with mine eyes, and upon the right side I saw a woman, and, behold, she mourned and wept with a loud voice, and was much grieved in heart, and her clothes were rent, and she had ashes upon her head.
verses.text_hr: Dok sam tako razmišljao, okrenuo sam se i s desne strane ugledao ženu. Tugovala je i glasno plakala, srce joj je bilo silno ožalošćeno, odjeća razderana, a glava posuta pepelom.

verses.text_en: Then let I my thoughts go that I was in, and turned me unto her,
verses.text_hr: Napustio sam svoje misli i okrenuo se prema njoj.

verses.text_en: And said unto her, Wherefore weepest thou? why art thou so grieved in thy mind?
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam joj: Zašto plačeš? Zašto si tako tužna u duši?

verses.text_en: And she said unto me, Sir, let me alone, that I may bewail myself, and add unto my sorrow, for I am sore vexed in my mind, and brought very low.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorila mi je: Gospodaru, pusti me da sama oplakujem i umnožim svoju žalost, jer sam u duši veoma uznemirena i duboko ponižena.

verses.text_en: And I said unto her, What aileth thee? tell me.
verses.text_hr: Upitao sam je: Što ti je? Reci mi.

verses.text_en: She said unto me, I thy servant have been barren, and had no child, though I had an husband thirty years,
verses.text_hr: Rekla mi je: Ja, tvoja službenica, bila sam nerotkinja i nisam imala djeteta, premda sam trideset godina imala muža.

verses.text_en: And those thirty years I did nothing else day and night, and every hour, but make my, prayer to the Highest.
verses.text_hr: I tih trideset godina ništa drugo nisam radila danju i noću, i svakoga sata, nego sam se molila Svevišnjemu.

verses.text_en: After thirty years God heard me thine handmaid, looked upon my misery, considered my trouble, and gave me a son: and I was very glad of him, so was my husband also, and all my neighbours: and we gave great honour unto the Almighty.
verses.text_hr: Nakon trideset godina Bog je uslišio svoju službenicu, pogledao moju bijedu, vidio moju nevolju i dao mi sina. Veoma sam mu se radovala, kao i moj muž i svi susjedi, a Svemogućemu smo iskazali veliku čast.

verses.text_en: And I nourished him with great travail.
verses.text_hr: I odgajala sam ga uz velike muke.

verses.text_en: So when he grew up, and came to the time that he should have a wife, I made a feast.
verses.text_hr: Kad je odrastao i došlo vrijeme da uzme ženu, pripravila sam svadbenu gozbu.
